root.name: Bird Opening: Swiss Gambit
root.moves: 1. f4 f5 2. e4 fxe4 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. g4

overview: White gives the e-pawn and then plays 4.g4, going for a wild kingside pawn storm. Black can take on g4 or return the extra material, and White has little to show for the pawns beyond open files and speed. Read from the moves.

white_ideas.idea: Continue with g5 and Bg2 to open lines
Win a piece back with Bg2 or Qe2 and attack the exposed king

black_ideas.idea: Take on g4 or play ...d5 and keep the extra material

typical_structures.structure: Open f- and g-files with White's king exposed

character.notes: Wild kingside pawn pushes and exposed kings on both sides.

gambit.notes: White has given a pawn or more and Black can keep it.

soundness.notes: Strong players consider the Swiss Gambit unsound.

structure.notes: Files open early on the kingside.
